findings.text: Item 2: previous F1 ADDRESSED (all three reproductions pass), but successful catch-up deletes floors that this guard prevents recapturing. In-memory ui-t18-catchup test: catch up 1..31, drop again, add 32..62 and refresh 33..62 before reconnect. Output: count=61, missing32=true, /5/messages?after=62. Capture floors for each new break without overwriting unresolved floors; add this regression. An in-memory recapture change makes it pass.

Item 2: retained gapFloors are ignored after SSE advances sseCursor. In-memory ui-t18-catchup test (FakeEventSource.CLOSED=2): load empty 4/5, add 1..31 to 5, deliver SSE 31 during 4's catch-up, fail 5's after page, then reconnect. Output: count=30, first=2, stream=/api/events?after=31, pages=[]. Retry pending floors independently of the live cursor and add this regression. An in-memory catch-up condition change restores all 31 messages.
